newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Unisource awarded Hong Kong mobile phone licence.
newsitem.headline: Unisource awarded Hong Kong mobile phone licence.

text.p: Unisource, a joint venture between PTT Telecom Netherlands, Sweden's Telia, Swiss Telecom PTT and Spain's Telefonica, said it had been awarded a mobile licence for advanced personal communications services in Hong Kong.
Unisource said in a statement that it planned to invest $300 million and to launch the services in the first quarter of 1997.
The contract, one of six mobile licenses awarded in Hong Kong, was awarded to the People's Phone consortium of which Unisource holds 22 percent.
The investment in the Personal Communications Services (PCS) network will be financed by the consortium's partners.
Other partners in the consortium include China Resources Ltd. with 54.5 percent, Telepaging Ltd. with 18 percent and Mobile Systems International (MSI) with 5.5 percent.
